text: The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Music Advisory Committee state that the Committee will hold up to four meetings per year at the call of the Chair or Vice-Chair on the delegation of the Chair. City staff will propose dates for public meetings of Toronto Music Advisory Committee in 2025, for member feedback and discussion. The following meetings are scheduled for 2025: Date: Tuesday, February 18, 2025 Time: 10:00 a.m. Location: Committee Room 2/Video Conference Date: Thursday, May 15, 2025 Time: 2:00 p.m. Location: Committee Room 2/Video Conference Date: Tuesday, October 07, 2025 Time: 2:00 p.m. Location: Committee Room 1/Video Conference Date: Monday, December 01, 2025 Time: 10:00 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1/Video Conference
The Toronto Music Advisory Committee received the item for information.
